The '''Earth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] where [[Spaceport THX1138]] and [[Tomorrowland Starport]] was located some time prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was located at the very edge of the galaxy.

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Earth/Legends|Earth]] was in the system.<ref name="Disneygo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This system was mentioned in the opening crawl shown during the grand opening of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]]. While there is nothing in the crawl or the ride itself to suggest that this refers to the system that includes our ''planet'' [[Wikipedia:Earth|Earth]], Earth is pictured on [[Disneyland]]'s ''Star Tours'' website.<ref name="Disneygo" />

===Non-canon content===
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
{{Quote|The bad news is that I have no idea where we are.|Han Solo|<ref name="great">{{Tales|19|Into the Great Unknown}}</ref>}}
After fleeing blindly into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] ended up in an '''[[Earth system|unfamiliar system]]''' that contained several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Earth/Legends|the homeworld]] of one [[Indiana Jones]]. In addition to Jones' homeworld, it also contained at least three other planets, [[Unidentified red planet|one being red]], [[Unidentified orange planet|another being orange]], and [[Unidentified yellow ringed planet|the third that was both yellow in color and was a ringed body]].<ref name="great" />
{{Noncanonend}}
